title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 301 East Congress Parkway in Crystal Lake, Illinois, as the "Ryan J. Cummings Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 301 East Congress Parkway in Crystal Lake, Illinois, as the Ryan J. Cummings Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Names the U.S. Postal Service building at 301 East Congress Parkway in Crystal Lake, Illinois, the Ryan J. Cummings Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a specific Postal Service facility in Crystal Lake, Illinois, after Ryan J. Cummings. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022.
